content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Corpus Christi

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and project-management experience. Review PMI's specific requirements for your background—whether you hold a bachelor's degree, associate degree, or high school diploma will determine your required experience hours. Granite PM Academy's advisors can clarify your eligibility before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. This formal education satisfies PMI's mandatory contact-hour requirement and covers the full PMBOK Guide framework. Our Corpus Christi cohorts run on flexible schedules; attend from your office, home, or anywhere with internet access.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Once you complete training, submit your formal application to PMI, documenting your education and project-management experience. Pay the PMI exam fee at the time of application. Granite PM Academy guides you through the submission process and answers questions about eligibility documentation.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides exam-preparation resources, practice exams, and instructor support to reinforce PMBOK content. Schedule your proctored exam through PMI's testing partner. Our team remains available to clarify difficult concepts and build your confidence before test day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, you'll maintain the PMP designation through PMI's standard three-year renewal cycle by earning Professional Development Units (PDUs). Granite PM Academy offers continuing-education courses and resources to help you accumulate PDUs and stay current in project-management practice.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.
